assets.prompt: Create a NEW dedicated login illustration for a Filipino children's reading app. First reference is the OLD LOGIN SCENE and is the COMPOSITION / CONTENT reference: a friendly purple owl on a short stack of school books, a Filipino elementary-school boy sitting beside it reading a purple book, a large tree framing the upper left, flowers and a winding garden path to a small school in the distance, blue sky and gentle warm morning light. Restore that welcoming storybook scene instead of an oversized close-up owl or rainbow banner. Second reference is only the PURPLE OWL IDENTITY reference: purple body, cream face and belly, amber eyes, golden beak/feet. Render the ENTIRE scene as polished HD TWO-DIMENSIONAL CHILDREN'S BOOK ILLUSTRATION: confident clean hand-inked outlines, intentional flat color areas with just one or two simple cel-shading tones, matte colors, clean silhouettes, restrained subtle paper texture. No 3D rendering, no glossy plastic, no volumetric glow, no depth-of-field blur, no photorealistic fur/feathers, no excessive specular eye highlights, no painterly airbrushed gradients. Natural charming proportions and tidy coherent linework. Maintain rich but gentle green, sky blue, purple and warm yellow palette. Not a generic giant owl portrait. SQUARE artwork designed for a tall website side panel: put both FULL characters together in the CENTRAL 55% of the width, from about 43% to 84% of image height, with generous scenery margins. Owl to the child's left; both complete and clearly visible, owl with exactly two wings and two feet, boy with natural two hands holding a book and two legs. Large tree trunk along left margin, leafy branches overhead, open sky upper center/right, small school far right midground. Keep top-left area calm for an HTML logo overlay. No rainbow, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no frame. Square high-resolution final illustration with clear readable forms at website sizes.
